battery.accumulator_activity.note: Battery accumulator activity below the 200 mA x V limit (brief assist, about -130 mW on calibration captures).

battery.accumulator_diagnostic.note: Accumulator intervals recorded without a registered unit scale (should not occur: the scale is registered).

battery.accumulator_excursion.note: An accumulator interval between in-force publications implies a mean battery power beyond 200 mA x V (0.001 W per unit, lane L1 units check): the charge accumulator above it (charging), or a positive discharge-accumulator mean beyond it, which a discharge-only sum cannot produce (sign-inconsistent; observed sign_inconsistent, as the hazard copy keeps it battery.member_span). A negative discharge-accumulator mean beyond the limit is battery assist (battery.assist, DISCLOSE) and never this code (ruling of 2026-10-06).

battery.accumulator_unavailable.note: The accumulator rule could not be evaluated on an interval; the publication rule still applies (60 s limitation).

battery.assist.note: Battery assist (ruling of 2026-10-06): a negative battery current, SMC B0AC below 0 mA, with ExternalConnected Yes and IsCharging No. Any negative read counts; -200 mA is the reporting threshold (smc_reads_below and the sampled duration below -200 mA are reported beside smc_reads_negative). Without SMC coverage (battery.smc_unavailable), a negative registry InstantAmperage or Amperage at a publication in force taken before the phase ends (registry_publications_negative), or a discharge-accumulator mean beyond 200 mA x V, stands in; with SMC coverage the 1 s reads decide. Recorded per phase (pre_request: prepare's tail, idle baseline and warm-up; request; post_request), each with smc_reads_negative, smc_reads_below, the minimum B0AC, the duration below -200 mA, registry_publications_negative and accumulator_intervals_over_limit; this code marks a member whose measured request was assisted, battery.assist_outside_request one assisted only in the other phases. observed.state_unread is true when a publication in force did not read IsCharging or ExternalConnected: that member is also battery.unmeasured (excluded) and its discharge is still disclosed. A span that read charging or AC loss is battery.member_span and carries no assist. The discharged energy goes to withheld/ only. Never removes a member or a window (calibration captures included); the analysis prints every reported cell with and without members that carry it (analysis plan 8.1).

battery.assist_outside_request.note: Battery assist (a negative battery current on AC while not charging, as battery.assist) seen only outside the member's measured request: in prepare's tail, the idle baseline, the warm-up or the post-request drift sentinel. Reported per phase with the same fields as battery.assist; it decides nothing (ruling of 2026-10-06, item 5), so the member stays in both lines of the sensitivity pair. Its discharged energy goes to withheld/ only.

battery.capture_pair_assist.note: The member's #421 per-capture battery pair failed on its endpoint current alone (the frozen grammar's unsigned |InstantAmperage| > 200 mA), every failed endpoint read a negative InstantAmperage from its raw bytes, the SMC B0AC reads cover the member and its battery join found no charging, AC loss or missing evidence. The discharge is disclosed in place of battery.capture_pair_failed, which this code names as the flag it replaced (ruling of 2026-10-06, item 4). Any other pair failure keeps battery.capture_pair_failed.

battery.capture_pair_failed.note: The member's #421 per-capture battery pair is present and failed, other than a discharge-only endpoint current failure the journal confirms (that one is battery.capture_pair_assist, DISCLOSE, ruling of 2026-10-06): charging or AC lost at an endpoint, an endpoint whose current sign could not be read from its raw bytes, or a member without SMC coverage or with a battery exclusion over its span.

battery.capture_pair_missing.note: #421 per-capture pair missing where the continuous journal does not cover the span; battery.unmeasured removes that member.

battery.capture_pair_missing_covered.note: #421 per-capture pair missing while the continuous journal covers the span.

battery.member_span.note: Charging or AC lost in the member's span (ruling of 2026-10-06): an SMC B0AC read in force above +200 mA (registry InstantAmperage or Amperage above +200 mA at an in-force publication under the SMC fallback); IsCharging Yes or ExternalConnected No at an in-force publication or any good registry read inside the span. The charge-accumulator test is battery.accumulator_excursion. Discharge alone is battery.assist (DISCLOSE).

battery.smc_unavailable.note: SMC B0AC reads (1 Hz) did not cover the span with good, fresh reads at most 5 s apart, so the registry InstantAmperage and Amperage at the in-force publications (republished about every 60 s) stood in for the current, under the same charging/assist split.

battery.unmeasured.note: The registered missing-evidence predicate, so the charging and AC state over the span is unknown. With SMC B0AC coverage: no registry publication in force at or before the span's start, an in-force publication that lacks IsCharging or ExternalConnected, or a hole of more than 120 s between good registry state reads (any read carrying both fields) over the span, the trailing hole measured to the span's end. Without SMC coverage: no registry publication for more than 120 s overlapping the span, or an in-force publication lacking a needed field. (An SMC gap alone is battery.smc_unavailable: the registry current stands in.)

calibration.acceptance_mismatch.note: The acceptance bytes are unreadable or differ from the plan tree's pin; the acceptance sets the bracket bound.

calibration.binding_failed.note: The bracket binding could not be built from the ledger, so the bracket cannot be evaluated.

calibration.bracket_acceptance_failed.note: The bracket fails the acceptance, evaluated with the acceptance's ledger-cutoff baseline.

calibration.capture_battery_assist.note: The battery join over a calibration capture's span found battery assist (a negative battery current on AC while not charging; battery.assist or battery.assist_outside_request on the capture). The capture's discharged energy goes to withheld/battery-assist.json. Never removes the window (ruling of 2026-10-06, item 4); charging, AC loss or a charge-accumulator excursion over the same span is calibration.capture_battery_span.

calibration.capture_battery_pair_assist.note: A calibration capture's #421 battery pair failed on its endpoint current alone, every failed endpoint read a negative InstantAmperage from its raw bytes, the capture span is covered by SMC B0AC reads and its battery join found no charging, AC loss or missing evidence. Disclosed in place of calibration.capture_battery_pair_failed, which it names as the flag it replaced (ruling of 2026-10-06, item 4). Any other pair failure keeps calibration.capture_battery_pair_failed.

calibration.capture_battery_pair_failed.note: A calibration capture's #421 battery pair failed, other than a discharge-only endpoint current failure the journal confirms (that one is calibration.capture_battery_pair_assist, DISCLOSE, ruling of 2026-10-06): charging or AC lost, an endpoint whose current sign could not be read, or a capture span without SMC coverage or with a battery exclusion. The bracket feeds every member's clock bound.

calibration.capture_battery_pair_unverif.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A1): the controller's per-member pre-slot battery pair verdict did not pass; the member runs and the fact is recorded (a recorded raw digest whose bytes are missing or changed still refuses). Claim status: the harvest re-derives the pair from the same bytes (calibration.capture_battery_pair_failed) and judges missing pair evidence from the continuous journal (calibration.capture_battery_unmeasured).

calibration.capture_battery_span.note: Core-prune N7 with the ruling of 2026-10-06: the battery rule joined over a calibration capture's span on the 1 s SMC B0AC reads gives charging, AC lost or an accumulator excursion (battery.member_span or battery.accumulator_excursion over the span, registration 6.4). The capture is not a valid calibration anchor. Discharge alone is calibration.capture_battery_assist (DISCLOSE).

calibration.capture_battery_unmeasured.note: Core-prune N7: a calibration capture's battery pair verdict did not pass and the journal cannot stand in for it: no capture span, no battery journal, a join that could not run, or the missing-evidence predicate of registration 6.4 (battery.unmeasured) over its span. The join reads the 1 s SMC reads, and the driver stops the monitor no sooner than 5 s after the chain exits (mock rehearsal round 3, R3-5).

calibration.capture_invalid.note: Pre or post calibration capture missing, not valid, or its artifacts differ from the ledger's recorded digests.

calibration.historical_custody_mismatch.note: The harvest re-hashed the historical calibration files the ledger records (calibration_ledger.historical_custody_report, once per window, this window's own bracket left out) and at least one file that is PRESENT has bytes that differ from the SHA-256 its ledger entry recorded (or a non-abandoned row records no artifact hashes). Only present bytes that differ count: a missing, evicted or unreadable file is calibration.historical_custody_unmeasured. The acceptance's screens and the bracket are judged against those captures, so the evidence is not what was judged. The slots skip this re-hash on the HAZARD path (calibration.writer_record_flagged, historical_custody_unverified).

calibration.historical_custody_unmeasure.note: historical_custody_report status unmeasured: a historical calibration file is missing (evicted from local iCloud storage, archived or deleted; observed.evicted counts these), present but unreadable, or its capture directory is missing or did not answer the bounded probe; or the ledger could not be read, or no observation was checked. Bytes that cannot be read are not shown to be wrong, so this is disclosed and the window is kept (refusal census, 2026-10-06); the hash chain and the pin are still checked. Present bytes that differ are calibration.historical_custody_mismatch.

calibration.ledger_not_ready.note: Desk ledger readiness refused; the chain's own reservation binds the window.

calibration.ledger_readiness_unmeasured.note: Desk ledger readiness could not run.

calibration.ledger_snapshot_refused.note: The calibration ledger, read up to this window's terminal entry, fails its own integrity checks (missing, malformed, broken digest chain, or the acceptance's cutoff entry, sequence 376, not found). The bracket's captures and the acceptance's screens are authenticated through this ledger, and the bracket evaluation reads the same snapshot and refuses with the same reasons, so calibration.bracket_acceptance_failed fires too. Window-removing costs no extra window and does not depend on that propagation (registration 6.5).

calibration.no_bracket.note: No finalized bracket session: includes a chain stopped before post-calibration by disk.low, the agent census or the deadline.

calibration.power_policy_unverified.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A14): the power-policy label check (CLI label against the recorded binding label, or the runtime policy derived from preflight strings) did not match or could not be read; recorded instead of refusing. A label, not a measured quantity (battery state is judged by the battery codes).

calibration.refit_cache_miss.note: The member re-ran the pre-slot calibration refit because the window calibration verdict was absent or did not match. Time only: the refit still verifies the same physics (PLAN2 M1).

calibration.session_not_bound.note: The bracket session names another plan, plan digest, window, evidence root or runs root.

calibration.writer_record_flagged.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A6-R1 to R3, A7, A8): a calibration writer or reservation record check that used to refuse (desk-predicted identity, committed pin or historical custody, a stale head pin, pmset displaysleepnow failing, binding strings missing from the powermetrics header) is recorded instead; observed.kind names the fact. Every kind has this one effect.

campaign.runner_record_flagged.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A4, A9, A13, A16, A20, V3): a campaign-runner record check that used to stop the stage (absent child metadata after a crash, a stale campaign lock, the GAMMA campaign-log analysis identity, an exception while writing a record or the stage verdict) is recorded instead; observed.kind names the fact. Window or member scope. Every kind has this one effect.

cell.below_minimum.note: A target cell kept fewer than rules.cell_unit_minimum units in a stratum (derived by the exclusion function).

census.journal_write_failed.note: A census result could not be appended to the census journal; the census itself ran and collection continued (PLAN2 row 7).

census.unmeasured.note: An in-window agent census could not be read on any of its retries; collection continued. Four consecutive unmeasured censuses stop the chain under their own stop code (PLAN2 row 7).

chain.stopped_before_collection.note: The chain journal holds no collection stage: the window is harvested as NO_COLLECTION with every collector run (PLAN2 2.2 F).

clock.frequency_changed.note: The kernel frequency word changed in the window; each member's own anchor bound stays authoritative.

clock.sntp_offset.note: Offset from a time server; enters no energy.

clock.step.note: A clock step in the monitor journal; members whose span it falls in get clock.step_overlap.

clock.step_overlap.note: A clock step (residual move > 1 ms between consecutive 1 Hz samples) falls inside the span.

clock.step_overlap_calibration.note: A clock step falls inside a calibration capture.

clock.systematic.note: At least 5 members with a recorded anchor status and more than half not bounded. Counted across attempts it is END STATE (registration 7.4).

clock.unmeasured.note: A gap in the 1 Hz clock journal; each member's own anchor bound stays authoritative.

code.executed_differs_from_sealed.note: Executed-file inventory differs from the sealed inventory; or chain bytes differ from their sidecar; or the checkout HEAD is not H_claim plus pin-only commits; or tracked edits or untracked files under the executed roots.

code.identity_unmeasured.note: The executed-code comparison could not run. A harvest problem first (registration 7.2).

collection.failure_histogram.note: The operator logs' error lines grouped by digit-masked text with counts and stages; full texts are withheld (PLAN2 2.2 F).

collection.zero_yield.note: The harvest found no bundle present for a COLLECTED window (PLAN2 2.2 F). cell.below_minimum and neg8.bound_not_derived exclude where it matters.

contention.kernel_task_share.note: kernel_task's CPU share during a request (excluded from the contention rule in the window). Cannot fire today: unprivileged ps never lists kernel_task (pid 0), so no share is journaled by name; its work is inside the host busy total, journaled and not judged.

contention.request_overlap.note: An outside process (not kernel_task) exceeds 0.05 CPU-s/s in an interval overlapping the member's request.

contention.unmeasured.note: Part of the member's request is covered by no ps interval.

cooldown.result_unknown.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A2, A19): the cooldown before a member returned unknown, or its probe raised or the adapter was unavailable; the member runs instead of the stage blocking. Claim status is still decided by member.cooldown_evidence_unverified.

diagnostic.s1_structural.note: s1's structural checks run on ALPHA-1's bytes (registration 3).

disk.low.note: Free disk below 10 GiB; the driver stops the chain, and the window gets calibration.no_bracket.

env.member_guard_flagged.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A11): the member environment guard recorded an unknown status or a capture error (not a measured quiet-state violation). The member runs; the reducer's environment claim barrier still excludes it from claims until LANE_BARRIER is registered.

env.member_quiet_state_violated.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A11): the member environment guard measured a quiet-state violation during the member; the stage continues and the member is excluded.

env.stage_preflight_not_admitted.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A10): the stage environment preflight raised or did not admit; the stage runs with a record shaped like a normal preflight. The reducer's environment claim barrier still excludes the affected members until LANE_BARRIER is registered.

g10.discharged.note: G10: the clock arm check refused a real network-time step.

g10.interrupted.note: G10 was interrupted by a signal; OFF ran.

g10.not_discharged.note: G10 did not discharge; one consult before BETA arms.

g10.unmeasured.note: G10 could not measure (a capture process was alive, or reads failed); one consult before BETA arms.

g3.assertion_failed.note: A G3 provenance assertion other than F5-2 failed.

g3.not_applicable.note: G3 does not apply (floor packs have no analysis manifest).

g3.recompute_failed.note: Aggregate: G3's F5-2 independent recompute of the whole-window verdict did not find a clean pass. Not window-removing for the same reason as whole_window.not_passed; its parts act through neg8.screen_failed, calibration.bracket_acceptance_failed and member.whole_window_member_failure (registration 6.5).

instrument.binary_identity_unmeasured.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A14): the powermetrics binary digest for this member's invocation could not be read, so the member cannot be tied to the calibrated binary. A present digest that differs from the calibrated one still refuses.

instrument.cadence_ratio_below_threshold.note: The sampler's cadence in the member's target phase is below the threshold.

instrument.insufficient_in_window_sample.note: Too few sampler records in the member's target phase.

instrument.precal_screen_failed.note: The pre-calibration fiducial bound exceeded the pre screen; the chain stops before member 1.

lineage.arm_decision_digest_differs.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.arm_decision_unrecorded.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.bundle_locator_digest_differs.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.bundle_stamp_absent.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.bundle_stamp_differs.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.collection_boot_unrecorded.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.completion_records_absent.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.context_root_differs.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.locator_noncanonical.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.locator_role_differs.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.locator_root_path_differs.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.locator_sidecar_mismatch.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.locator_unreadable.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.pack_digest_unrecorded.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.plan_tree_digest_differs.note: The pack's plan_tree.json bytes differ from the digest recorded in the window lineage at publication.

lineage.record_chain_unverified.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

lineage.sibling_lineage_differs.note: Window-lineage records audit finding (joulewise/window_lineage.py). Configuration bytes are checked per member at write time; the plan-tree digest is pack identity.

member.admission_aborted.note: Idle admission refused the member after its one immediate retry.

member.anchor_energy_envelope_exceeded.note: Target-phase precheck anchor_energy_envelope_exceeds_quarter_metric; computed from a science energy.

member.anchor_not_bounded.note: Per-member clock anchor status is not bounded (5 ms effective bound, 60 s fit span).

member.anchor_recompute_mismatch.note: The harvest's recomputed anchor status differs from the recorded one.

member.bytes_ambiguous.note: Two admissible bundles for one member; neither is used (derived).

member.bytes_missing.note: A required bundle file is missing, or the member has no admissible bundle (derived).

member.config_not_in_inventory.note: The member's configuration bytes are not in the pack's committed inventory.

member.cooldown_cap_hit.note: The member's cooldown reached the 300 s cap.

member.cooldown_evidence_unverified.note: The member's campaign cooldown evidence does not verify.

member.idle_admission_telemetry_missing.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A18): every failed idle-admission condition was an evidence condition (CPU telemetry missing, malformed or too few samples; GPU admission unknown), so the member runs; its idle-window quietness is unmeasured. A threshold failure still retries and aborts as before.

member.reduction_mismatch.note: Re-reduction is not byte-identical to the stored summary.

member.retried.note: The member was measured by the one retry of the NEG-8 corpus stage (registration 5.2-5.3; PLAN2 row 13). The retry is a fresh measurement; the flag records that it was a retry.

member.span_unknown.note: The member's sampler span cannot be placed, so the physics-in-span rules cannot be applied.

member.stderr_uncopied.note: The member's stderr file did not reach the stage log, so a core flag printed there behind the unwritten-flag marker could not be read from that log (the harvest still scans operator-logs/member-stderr). A record that was not written, not a measured fault: disclosed, the member is kept (orchestrator, 2026-10-06, under 'physics refuses; everything else is a flag'; it was EXCLUDE_MEMBER).

member.strict_validation_failed.note: Strict bundle validation, which re-reduces the raw evidence, failed or could not run.

member.target_phase_precheck_failed.note: The member's target phase (decode or prefill) fails its precheck.

member.timeout.note: The member's child was killed at the 1,800 s wall-clock cap. A member stopped by its cap is not a completed measurement (PLAN2 row 8).

member.token_count_mismatch.note: Runtime-observed token counts differ from the registered counts.

member.unreadable.note: A required bundle file is unreadable.

member.whole_window_member_failure.note: The whole-window verdict lists this member among its per-member failures (member_failures) for a reason no other member code carries: environment evidence missing or failed (including the post-run display-asleep and screensaver-off observation of D-078 item 4), CPU-idle criteria or GPU idle admission that do not replay, or an idle-admission attempt that cannot be paired with its telemetry. In-window thermal pressure and an invalid bundle keep their own codes. The harvest emits one flag per such member at int4 (harvest.WHOLE_WINDOW_MEMBER_FAILURE_REASONS: the verdict's member_failures reason codes less thermal_pressure_elevated_in_window and whole_window_bundle_invalid), with its reasons and details; verdict authenticity does not gate it, and an absent or malformed list names no member (recorded on whole_window.not_passed as observed.member_failures).

meter.absent.note: KM003C whole-machine DC-in stream: no stream file, an absent header, or no samples.

meter.battery_activity.note: KM003C stream: an SMC B0AC read inside a member window is nonzero (battery discharge or charge). A diagnostic of the meter's battery term; the member rule is battery.member_span / battery.assist.

meter.clock_fit_residual.note: KM003C stream: the largest excess latency above the fitted clock envelope exceeds 2 sample periods (40 ms at 50 SPS), or no fit was possible.

meter.drops_excess.note: KM003C stream: dropped samples exceed 0.5 % of kept plus dropped.

meter.duplicates.note: KM003C stream: the meter re-delivered samples that the parser dropped.

meter.pdtr_gain_out_of_band.note: KM003C stream: the median over 1 s bins of mean SMC PDTR over mean meter power is outside 0.95-1.02, or cannot be computed.

meter.supervision_fault.note: The driver's supervision of the KM003C wall-meter reader (MonitorSupervisor name meter) recorded a fault: start_failed (a start or restart failed; observed.start_failures), crash_loop, not_proven_stopped or record_failed. The meter is a diagnostic beside the rail estimate; this code never refuses, is never a fault reason and removes nothing. With no meter attached the driver does not restart it (meter.absent).

meter.vbus_out_of_contract.note: KM003C stream: a sample's Vbus is outside 26.6-29.4 V (the 28 V EPR contract plus or minus 5 %).

model.identity_inconsistent_in_window.note: Two distinct model or runtime identities within one identity unit of one window.

model.identity_mismatch.note: Model, tokenizer or runtime realized at arm or recorded in a bundle differs from the frozen pins.

model.identity_underivable.note: The member's model and runtime identity cannot be derived from its own metadata; which model was measured is unproven for that member.

model.identity_unmeasured.note: The model identity comparison could not run. A harvest problem first (registration 7.2).

model.identity_unpinned.note: No pin to compare against. The pins are configs/campaigns/v5_claim_25g83/identity_pins.json (schema joulewise.b5_identity_pins.v1), sealed with this catalog; the plan trees' identity_pin_projection is unprojected and carries none. Fires when the measurement checkout lacks the file (arm collector) or its archived copy has no unit pin (harvest) (registration 4.6 item 3).

monitor.crash_loop.note: The hazard monitor kept exiting within 30 s of its start and was restarted with backoff. Members whose spans the monitor did not cover carry battery.unmeasured and contention.unmeasured (EXCLUDE_MEMBER) from the joins (PLAN2 row 11).

monitor.outage.note: The hazard monitor wrote no battery or contention reading for the outage bound (about 10 min) and the driver stopped the chain, as it does on disk.low (PLAN2 row 11). The members in the silent stretch carry battery.unmeasured and contention.unmeasured (EXCLUDE_MEMBER) from the joins; this flag records the stop.

monitor.probe_in_phase.note: A monitor probe fell inside a target phase.

monitor.restarted.note: The hazard monitor was restarted by the driver; the gap appears as the modules' unmeasured flags.

neg8.bound_not_derived.note: The NEG-8 bound was not derived: neither the core reader (all 12 corpus members) nor the harvest's collected-subset validation (at least 10 of 12, committed order, only unsucceeded members left out, bound arithmetic and corpus identity checked against the custodied manifest) accepts it (registration 5.3).

neg8.corpus_member_dropped.note: Core-prune N2: a succeeded NEG-8 corpus member was left out of the bound's custodied manifest because the core's NEG-8 mint drops it for a registered member-validity reason (the harvest's NEG8_ACCEPTED_DROP_REASONS). Any other left-out succeeded member makes a selected corpus and gives neg8.bound_not_derived.

neg8.screen_failed.note: The NEG-8 screen failed: the verdict's NEG-8 bracket is absent or not passed, or lists a NEG-8 condition (neg8_gross_point_drift_exceeded, neg8_idle_sub_point_drift_exceeded, neg8_bracket_missing, neg8_bracket_reference_invalid, neg8_drift_bound_stale, the bound-underived conditions). When the only conditions are the bound-underived ones and the bound was derived from the collected subset, the harvest's re-screen against that bound decides alone (registration 5.3).

network_time.off_output.note: Output of the network-time OFF action at the arm; recorded only, never read for wording.

pack.identity_mismatch.note: Pack plan tree, a configuration, prompt pin, extraction spec, NEG-8 or reference manifest differs from the sealed inventory or the plan tree's own pins (recomputed at harvest).

pack.identity_unmeasured.note: The pack identity comparison could not run. A harvest problem first: R3 and re-harvest on identical bytes before re-arming (registration 7.2).

records.arm_record_absent.note: hazards/arm.json is absent although the chain started.

records.auxiliary_match_raised.note: The external-member auxiliary configuration match raised an exception. The refusal it causes stands; this flag records its cause (PLAN2 row 5).

records.checkout_untracked.note: Untracked files in the measurement checkout outside the executed roots.

records.collector_failed.note: A harvest collector failed; the number-protecting ones also emit their own unmeasured code.

records.identity_unmeasured_superseded.note: An arm collector's *.identity_unmeasured flag was superseded because the harvest re-derived every check that collector performs (PLAN2 row 12). The original flag is kept in the record.

records.lineage_formality.note: A lineage formality other than configuration bytes.

records.lineage_prelaunch_mismatch.note: The driver's pre-launch lineage check found a runs-root locator absent, unreadable, rejected by the members' authenticator, or naming another window's plan, window or bracket session. Recorded with the observed and expected values; the chain launches. Only a boot changed since publication refuses (night_refused_boot_changed).

records.monitor_journal_absent.note: A monitor journal is absent; its members get the module's unmeasured flag.

records.monitor_line_malformed.note: A monitor journal line is malformed.

records.runs_root_override.note: The harvest read a runs root given by an override rather than the plan's (PLAN2 row 18).

records.source_changed_during_harvest.note: Bytes the harvest reads changed while it read them; the harvested numbers may not be the collected ones. A harvest problem first (registration 7.2).

records.terminal_record_absent.note: The driver's terminal record is absent.

records.window_not_launched.note: A NULL window (no chain launched): why, from the arm decision and the hazard result records as found (each read, absent or unreadable): go, the arm error and its type, the refusal reasons, the modules not passing, the verdict and the stage reached, with digits masked. Mock rehearsal round 3, R3-4. Disclosure only; a window that never launched holds no members.

roster.before_chain_started.note: A bundle created before chain.started; it is ignored, not used.

roster.creation_unplaced.note: A bundle with no stamp that places it after chain.started (no sampler, controller or run_started stamp); it is ignored, not used, like an early one. Derived by the exclusion function. Added after the end-to-end rehearsal, round 1 (B7).

roster.dispatch_unresolved.note: A stage's member dispatch could not be resolved from its config-dir order manifest (J3); its members were taken from the stage input as before (PLAN2 row 14).

roster.duplicate_run_id.note: The plan tree launches (or lists) one run id more than once; the campaign runner skips a run id whose bundle exists, so every planned position after the first is never measured and the window is not the registered design (as GAMMA's interior references did until lane L10 gave them distinct run ids). Added after the end-to-end rehearsal, round 1 (B3).

roster.foreign_attempt.note: A bundle bound to another attempt; it is ignored, not used.

roster.horizon_truncated.note: The chain reached its collection deadline (pre-capture + 86,400 s minus settle, post-capture and margin) and stopped launching members so the post-calibration stays inside the 24 h horizon. The unlaunched members are absent from the roster; cell.below_minimum excludes where that matters (PLAN2 row 17).

roster.no_science_bundles.note: No planned science member has a bundle.

roster.not_in_plan.note: A bundle not in the plan roster; it is ignored, not used.

roster.run_id_mismatch.note: The bundle's metadata.json run_id differs from its directory. A misfiled bundle already fails the per-member config check; this covers a bundle whose own records disagree about which member it is. A kept member needs one identity in every record a later program may key on, or one energy could count under two units or the wrong quad position. Emitter class REPRESENTATION, restated NUMBER here (registration 6.7).

stage.members_refused_pre_bundle_identic.note: Three consecutive members ended without a bundle and with the same child refusal line (digits masked): a shared, likely deterministic cause (PLAN2 2.2 B, E). Changes no number.

supervision.pass_failed.note: A step of the driver's one-second supervision pass raised; it is flagged once per step and the pass went on. A record fault never ends the chain (PLAN2 row 10).

teardown.survivors.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A17): the sampler teardown report or the runtime cleanup after the member's measured window was not clean; recorded instead of failing the member (no further signals are sent). The next members' physics is measured by the contention journal (contention.request_overlap) and their own idle admission.

thermal.battery_temperature_unmeasured.note: A cooldown release in the stage has no readable battery-thermistor reading, so the stage's rise was not fully measured; the reference members and the NEG-8 screen still carry the drift check (registration 0.6).

thermal.os_level_nonzero.note: An in-force 5 s OS thermal-pressure sample is nonzero.

thermal.powermetrics_pressure_elevated.note: The member's own powermetrics records show elevated thermal pressure.

thermal.stage_battery_rise.note: Battery thermistor read at each cooldown release: the stage's last reading minus its first exceeds 3 K and its last three readings do not lie within 0.5 K of each other (no plateau). Reported beside the window's NEG-8 result; never excludes (registration 0.6, timing ruling 2026-10-06). Emitter lands with the run_campaign.py logging lane.

thermal.unmeasured.note: A gap in OS thermal samples; the member's own powermetrics records still carry thermal pressure.

whole_window.not_passed.note: Aggregate: the stored whole-window verdict did not pass. It fails on any one member's failure, so it is not window-removing. Its parts act through their own codes: neg8.screen_failed and calibration.bracket_acceptance_failed (window), member.whole_window_member_failure (member); adapter wattage continuity is disclosed (registration 6.5).

whole_window.producer_failed.note: The desk producer of the binding or verdict failed; an absent verdict is whole_window.verdict_absent.

whole_window.verdict_absent.note: No whole-window verdict file, so the NEG-8 screen held in it was not evaluated. A harvest problem first (registration 7.2).

whole_window.verdict_unauthenticated.note: The whole-window verdict row does not authenticate against the campaign log.

yield.harvest_disagrees_with_window.note: The harvest's member counts differ from the driver's in-window stage_yield.jsonl (PLAN2 2.2 F).

yield.stage_low.note: In-window yield tripwire: a collection stage ended with fewer succeeded members than its min_valid (PLAN2 2.2 A-B). Counts only; changes no number.

yield.stage_stalled.note: In-window yield tripwire: no new bundle directory and no new chain journal line for the stall bound (PLAN2 2.2 B). Changes no number.

yield.stage_zero.note: In-window yield tripwire: a collection stage ended with no bundle present out of a positive planned count (PLAN2 2.2 B). Counts only; changes no number.

notes.aggregate_disclosures: whole_window.not_passed and g3.recompute_failed are DISCLOSE because they fail on any single member's failure. Their window-level parts are neg8.screen_failed (emitted by the harvest, with the collected-subset re-screen) and calibration.bracket_acceptance_failed; their member-level part is member.whole_window_member_failure.
